caption: The drawing is a pencil sketch on a beige or off-white background, featuring a metal tankard with a large handle and a hinged lid. The tankard has a rounded body that slightly tapers towards the top and sits on a ridged base. There is finely inscribed text on the front of the tankard: "Warrie. A gift from his Grandfather C. Dec 25, 1852." The handle is substantial, arching smoothly from the top to the bottom, and is attached near the hinge of the lid. The lid itself is flat, with a small ornamental finial and a lever mechanism. In the upper right corner, there is an inset technical drawing in line style, showing a side view of the tankard with measurements and scale indicated. In the lower left corner, another inset provides an enlarged detail of the area where the handle attaches to the body, focusing on the decorative and structural elements. The entire composition is contained within a rectangular border. The shading gives a metallic appearance to the main object, and the drawing is rendered in monochrome tones of pencil grey.
title: Silver Tankard
